$comment: License policy for npm dependencies (prod and dev), checked by scripts/check-licenses.mjs. 'allowed' passes; 'dataOnly' and 'review' fail unless the package has an exception; 'denied' always fails unless excepted. SPDX 'A OR B' passes if any option passes; 'A AND B' only if all do. Exceptions are per package, must give a reason and must match the reported license exactly.

caniuse-lite.reason: Browser support data read by browserslist/Babel at build time (via @vitejs/plugin-legacy). It is not shipped in the app bundle.

json-schema.reason: Dual licensed; we use it under BSD-3-Clause. Dev-only, pulled in by Cypress (@cypress/request > http-signature > jsprim).
